testResults.name: Fold8 SM- Cross-Type & Trade Up Leakage Prevention
testResults.description: Fold8 naked device (SM-F971, SM-F976) must NOT receive Pass F promo or Trade Up Net 64,900 as standard payment
testResults.evidence: All SM-F971 and SM-F976 have NORMAL sale mode with RRP (61,900 / 69,900 / 85,900). No 64,900 Net price leaks into standard/SF+.

testResults.name: Fold8 Pass F Unproven Promo Quarantine
testResults.description: F-NS971BLVGTHL showing SF_PLUS 64,900 must be BLOCKED with PROMOTION_TYPE_NOT_PROVEN
testResults.evidence: Variant STOCK-R121-FOLD8-UNPROVEN is BLOCKED with error PROMOTION_TYPE_NOT_PROVEN. Normal baseline RRP 69,900 remains available.

testResults.name: S25 FE Separation of SF+ and Standard Payment
testResults.description: S25 FE must have separate SF+ (Coupon 01, down <=10%) and Standard Payment (Coupon 02, Net 17,900/20,900 with warning 'ราคานี้ไม่ร่วม SF+')
testResults.evidence: S25 FE 128GB has SF+ Net 19,900 (Coupon 01) and Standard Net 17,900 (Coupon 02). Zero NON_SF legacy mode remains.

testResults.name: Student Promo Strict Coupon & Source Rate Validation
testResults.description: Student variants must strictly use Coupon 'Studentcrd', sfPlusEligible=false, tradeUpEligible=false, and rate strictly from source file
testResults.evidence: All Student variants have couponCode='Studentcrd', sfPlusEligible=False, and calculate netPrice strictly from source student rate.

testResults.name: Tab A11 / A11+ SF+ Coupon 04 Support
testResults.description: Tab A11/A11+ must separate Standard (Coupon 01/02) from SF+ (Coupon 04, down <=10%). Prohibit false 'Coupon 04 = Not SF+' rule.
testResults.evidence: Tab A11+ 5G has Standard 8,990 and SF+ 9,990 (Coupon 04). Tab A11 LTE has Standard 5,990 (Coupon 01) and SF+ 6,990 (Coupon 04).

testResults.name: SmartTag2 Bundle 2 Qty Strict Policy
testResults.description: SmartTag2 must be BUNDLE qty=2 for 1,590 with no coupon. Single item (qty=1) must not be sold for 795 (must use regular RRP 1,090).
testResults.evidence: SmartTag2 variant has saleMode='BUNDLE', netPrice=1590, couponCode=None, and condition explicitly prohibiting single item split.

testResults.name: Accessory 75 Formula Error Quarantine
testResults.description: 75 accessory variants with #ERROR! in rows 70-144 must be BLOCKED with SOURCE_FORMULA_ERROR. Zero price guessing.
testResults.evidence: Exactly 75 variants are BLOCKED with validationErrors=['SOURCE_FORMULA_ERROR']. Net price is None/#ERROR!.

testResults.name: Expired 2025 Premium Gift Rejection
testResults.description: Premium gifts from sheet 'Promotion Premium Q2.2026' with 2025 dates (1 July - 30 Sep 2025) must be BLOCKED and not attached to 2026 items.
testResults.evidence: All 2025 premium variants are BLOCKED with EXPIRED_PREMIUM. Active 2026 inventory items have 0 expired premium gifts attached.
